response.query: What interim analysis and stopping rules (Bayesian posterior thresholds or frequentist alpha-spending) will be pre-specified, and how will adaptive sample-size changes be controlled and reported?
response.answer: Interim analyses in adaptive trials use Bayesian posterior thresholds or frequentist alpha-spending rules for stopping. Sample-size changes are controlled and reported through pre-specified adjustments based on interim results.
